meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for caveman modes, skills and commands. Trigger: /caveman-help or "caveman help".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随手调出速查卡,弄清有哪些模式和指令可用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常记不清有哪些模式和命令可以调用
copy.tagline_en: Pull up a cheat sheet to see which modes and commands are available
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep forgetting which modes and commands exist

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-help 或说 “caveman help” 后，Claude 会打印一张速查卡，列出各 caveman 模式、配套技能和命令及其触发词。它只展示一次，不改模式、不写标记文件、不留存任何东西。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-help 或说 “caveman help” 时触发；它只输出卡片，不会切换模式，也不保存设置。

say.note: 输出模式、技能、命令速查卡

say.text: caveman help 里的 wenyan 模式是什么？
say.note: 卡片列出文言文模式及其触发词

howto.what_en: Once installed, /caveman-help or "caveman help" makes Claude print a reference card listing caveman modes, companion skills and commands with their triggers. One-shot: it does not change mode, write flag files, or persist anything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-help or say "caveman help". It only prints the card; it does not switch modes or save anything.

say_en.note: Prints the modes, skills and commands card.

say_en.text: What is the wenyan mode in caveman help?
say_en.note: Card lists wenyan modes and triggers.
